title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Empty〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, so next you...take the string from your middle left finger using your right pinkie.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like...this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, good job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So... I'll say the next step.
Now you need to use your other pinkie to...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're getting good at cat's cradle, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks...
But, since you taught me so much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'd like Mafuyu and everyone to see it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, me too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, so... Mafuyu and the others are about to go up a year, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I don't really get what that means...
What's gonna change for them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I only know what the others have told me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They said that Mizuki will be a second-year, and that Ena and Mafuyu will be third-years.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They also told me they'll have almost entirely new classrooms and classmates...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I've heard about that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sounds kinda sad to get separated from the people you were with for so long...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mizuki and Mafuyu didn't seem too bothered about it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They didn't...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
But, it's good to not be sad...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... A lot's gonna change when they go up a year, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are they going to change too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...
I don't know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As much as I'm sure a new school year is an important milestone, it's not like everyone suddenly becomes a different person on their birthday or anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nothing big is going to change... I think.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you want them to change, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I don't know.
Change seems so difficult and painful, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like with Mafuyu recently...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. For Mafuyu and the others, I think change can be very painful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Even still, Mafuyu fought hard.
She protected herself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm...very happy that she put herself first.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... Me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As they are now, they might change by themselves.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But what about us?
Will we have nothing to do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That would actually be a good thing. But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But we will still be here to watch over them.
That won't change.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll stay by their sides and offer support whenever something happens to them... We'll fight with them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm going to think hard about what I can do for them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you want to think together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay.
